race.comment: THINK LIKE PADDY (1) talented gelding ready to get off the mark at start five. Taken back from the outside gate and never got into the contest with a battling seventh over 1815m at Eagle Farm in BM70 class. Gets the right run today and will prove hard to stop. REDCLOUD (4) progressing well with the two wins from his last three outings in weaker grade. Appreciated the jump in trip from the good barrier with a commanding come from behind victory over 1500m at Warwick. Among the winning hopes in this vein of form. LAMBERTINA (3) is on the quick back up after sitting on the pace and boxing on to finish second over 1400m at Dalby. Has the speed to overcome the sticky gate and stays in the calculations. CHEERFUL CAT (7) drops in trip and weight after he kept finding to run third over 1900m at Kilcoy. Deep into the prep and worth thought.
